comingLast.roast: single figures and last - the committee has questions and no answers
on 19 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
1 left, 3 needed, one bar holding its breath
he needs 3 points and a small miracle - the bar has odds on both
the good news: 3 points saves him. the bad news: current form says 1.3 a hole
7 from his last 3 - grandstand finish at the wrong end
averaging 1.2 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
needs 7 to escape - the most supported man on the course right now
8 points to safety - his back nine just became the main event
3 holes left to avoid the double blue - 4 points does it
